claims.text: Cambridge Beaches has welcomed guests for oceanfront escapes since 1923.

findings.quote: Cambridge Beaches has been a treasured destination for oceanfront escapes since 1923
A historic landmark originally opened as a hotel in 1923

claims.text: Every accommodation has a private entrance, a dedicated outdoor seating area and views.

findings.quote: every accommodation at Cambridge Beaches boasts a private entrance, a dedicated outdoor seating area, and stunning views.

claims.text: Water View Rooms feature bespoke furniture and artwork by Bermudian artists.

findings.quote: Cozy rooms with fresh design highlighted by bespoke furniture, authentic artwork by Bermudian artists, vibrant colours, and coastal water views.

claims.text: King's Point is a five-bedroom private residence on a 4.5-acre peninsula, with butler and housekeeping services.

findings.quote: An extraordinary five-bedroom private residence set on a 4.5-acre peninsula, surrounded by secluded coves, private beaches, and sweeping water views, with butler and housekeeping services and access to Cambridge Beaches amenities.

claims.text: The Aquarian Baths inside the Ocean Spa have an indoor pool, a jacuzzi, a sauna, a steam room, a crystal therapy room and a cold-rain shower.

findings.quote: Located inside the Ocean Spa, the Aquarian Baths feature an indoor pool, jacuzzi and multiple experience suites including a sauna, steam room, crystal therapy room, and cold-rain shower.

claims.text: Ocean Spa uses Caudalie products in all of its treatments.

findings.quote: We proudly use the finest _**Caudalie**_ products in all of our treatments

claims.text: Ocean Spa offers organic Irish seaweed rituals from VOYA.

findings.quote: From VOYA's organic Irish seaweed rituals

claims.text: Long Bay Beach is the longest of the four private beaches and a vantage point for sunsets.

findings.quote: The longest of our four private beaches, Long Bay Beach offers a perfect locale for lounging in the sand and is a spectacular vantage point to take in magical Bermudian sunsets.

claims.text: Oleander Cycles, on site, rents scooters, e-bikes and electric vehicles.

findings.quote: ### Scooter, E-Bike & Electric Vehicle Rental
Get out and explore Bermuda with a rental from Oleander Cycles. Located on-site at Cambridge Beaches

claims.text: The resort has a tennis court, pickleball and a basketball court.

findings.quote: Practice your serve on our tennis court, play a game of pickleball, or practice your shot on our basketball court.

claims.text: Sunken Harbor Club is the Bermuda chapter of the cocktail bar created by St. John Frizell, run as a dockside tavern and tropical cocktail bar.

findings.quote: The Bermuda Chapter of the cocktail bar created by St. John Frizell takes its form at Cambridge Beaches as a dockside tavern and tropical cocktail bar

claims.text: Breezes is an alfresco oceanside restaurant serving lunch and dinner, where longtail birds, grey herons and even sea turtles may be sighted.

findings.quote: Enjoy inspired menus at lunch and dinner; linger oceanside with an expertly mixed cocktail; and take pleasure in the possibility of sighting Longtail Birds, Grey Herons, and even sea turtles from your alfresco table.

claims.text: The resort has four private beaches and two private coves.

findings.quote: Cambridge Beaches is home to four private beaches and two private coves.

claims.text: Private Pool Water View Cottages have a private swim-up plunge pool overlooking the Atlantic Ocean or Mangrove Bay.

findings.quote: Offering an exclusive experience, our Private Pool Water View Cottages feature a private swim-up plunge pool overlooking the Atlantic Ocean or Mangrove Bay.

claims.text: King's Point was once the home of Bermudian explorer Teddy Tucker.

findings.quote: is one of Bermuda’s most storied coastal homes—once the residence of legendary Bermudian explorer Teddy Tucker.

claims.text: An infinity-edge pool overlooks Mangrove Bay.

findings.quote: two pools, an infinity-edge pool that overlooks shimmering Mangrove Bay
Relax in a serene setting overlooking Mangrove Bay

claims.text: H2O Sports, on site, rents kayaks, paddleboards, sailboats and motorboats for exploring coves, coral reefs and shipwrecks just offshore.

findings.quote: Get out on the water in a kayak, paddleboard, sailboat, or motorboat and explore hidden beaches and coves, coral reefs, and shipwrecks just offshore. Located on-site at Cambridge Beaches.

claims.text: The resort is not ADA accessible.

findings.quote: Please note that Cambridge Beaches is not ADA accessible.

claims.text: Ocean Spa treatments are for guests aged 16 and over.

findings.quote: The Ocean Spa welcomes guests 16 years and older for spa treatments.

claims.text: Downtown Hamilton is a 30-minute ferry ride away.

findings.quote:
Downtown Hamilton
**30-Minute Ferry Ride**
